name: Dark Iron
玄铁
description: Reinforces a forged weapon's durability and repair yield.
用于坚韧专长，提高成器耐久与维修效率。
acquisition: Mine dark iron veins in deep caves with an iron pickaxe.
用铁镐开采深层洞穴中的玄铁矿脉。

name: Spirit Copper Ingot
赤铜锭
description: Conducts spiritual power, reducing learned Sword Qi costs.
用于导灵专长，降低已学剑气的耗灵。
acquisition: Infuse copper ingots with your qi at a forging ding; accepts the common copper ingot tag.
在炼器鼎中给铜锭灌灵，兼容通用铜锭标签。

name: Edge-tempering Sand
淬锋砂
description: Tempers a keen edge, increasing forged weapon attack damage.
用于锋锐专长，提高成器攻击伤害。
acquisition: Dig visible deposits on riverbanks and in shallows with a shovel.
用铲采集河滩和浅水处可见的淬锋砂层。
